contentPattern.structure: illustrative image + heading + tagline + static form fields (name; +91(IND) mobile; city/state) + submit button

suitableFor: static contact / consult / callback lead forms
image + short form panels reproduced faithfully as static markup
'drop your number and we'll call you back' style panels
notSuitableFor: forms requiring real submission / backend validation (use a forms integration)

notes: Custom static block: no vanilla 'form' block exists in the library and the forms-excat plugin was not available, so this was created as a standard custom block per block-variant-manager fallback. The form is inert (no submission handler).
